profile.name: 属性连接组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件连接组件，用于将两个对象的属性绑定在一起。在实验软件模型或界面中，它可用于维护源对象与目标对象之间的属性同步，并记录源/目标对象标识及对应的属性名。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software connection component that binds the properties of two objects together. In experiment software models or user interfaces, it is used to maintain synchronization between a source object's property and a target object's property, while storing the source/target specifiers and property names.

registry.name: Connection between two objects
registry.description: Property Connection是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, clone等操作。
